meta: Ask AI to write a bedtime story with your child's name: kids listen more closely when the hero has their name, and AI writes it in a minute.

muc.title: Your child is the hero
muc.text: Kids listen more closely when the main character has their name. AI writes that story in a minute.

muc.title: Name, age, lesson
muc.text: Tell AI your child's nickname, age, favorite animal and one lesson, like waiting your turn.

muc.title: Short, gentle, calm ending
muc.text: Ask for about three minutes of reading, short sentences, no scary scenes, ending with a peaceful bedtime.

muc.title: Nicknames only
muc.text: Use only the nickname; don't give the full name, school or address. Skim the story before telling it.

muc.title: Tonight's story
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for tonight's story, with your child and their favorite animal, about brushing teeth.
